label: Padded families over Dedekind domains
gloss: A lemma about padding families of elements so they span a free module over a localized number ring.

label: Norms of natural numbers in p-adic closure
gloss: A lemma bounding the p-adic size of natural numbers not divisible by p, inside an algebraic closure.

label: Total degree of partial derivatives
objects: Partial derivative of a multivariate polynomial
gloss: A lemma showing that taking a partial derivative of a polynomial lowers its total degree by at most one.

label: Periodic functions and finite sums
gloss: A small lemma about periodic functions evaluated on products and sums of integers, over a number ring.

label: Places over a prime ideal
gloss: A lemma about which places of a number field lie over a given prime, using ideal norms and divisibility.

label: Positive definite Hermitian quadratic forms
gloss: A lemma showing that a real quadratic form scaled by a complex matrix stays positive definite.

label: Eigenvectors of matrix powers
gloss: A lemma about how matrix powers act on vectors, relating them to eigenvectors through polynomial evaluation.

label: Eigenvalues of matrix powers
gloss: A lemma about how matrix powers act on vectors, relating them to eigenvalues through polynomial evaluation.

label: Powers of module endomorphisms
gloss: A lemma computing how powers of a linear map act on elements, through polynomial evaluation.

label: Polynomial images in submodules
gloss: A lemma showing that polynomials in a linear map send a submodule into itself.

label: Permutation products and determinants
gloss: A lemma about products over permutations and matrix determinants, including a derivative identity for such products.

label: Rank one forms on group orbits
gloss: A lemma about rank one linear forms built from a group action, and the span of an orbit of vectors.

label: Scalar extension of simple modules
gloss: A lemma about simple modules over algebraically closed fields, showing that endomorphisms have eigenvalues.

label: Additive valuation of finite products
gloss: A lemma about how an additive valuation on a discrete valuation ring behaves on finite products.

label: Simultaneous eigenvectors of commuting operators
gloss: A lemma showing that commuting linear maps share a common eigenvector on a finite-dimensional space.

label: Scalar multiples of list sums
gloss: A lemma showing that scaling a sum of list elements keeps the result inside the submodule they span.

label: Twisted idempotents for irreducible representations
gloss: A lemma about idempotents built from a group action on a Galois-irreducible representation, with eigenspace arguments.

label: Published automorphic form inputs
gloss: A large set of imported results on automorphic forms, Galois representations and base change, organized in subfolders.

label: Formal tower lemmas
gloss: Contains one import file and a subfolder of formal lemmas about towers of field extensions.

label: Units killing idempotent modules
gloss: A lemma showing that certain units of a Noetherian ring annihilate elements of a module, using idempotents.

label: Weil representation core definitions
gloss: Core definitions for Weil representations, with a subfolder on Zariski density.

label: Open cones of positive definite matrices
gloss: A lemma showing that a cone defined by positivity conditions on Hermitian matrices is open.

label: Approximation in finite adele rings
gloss: A lemma about approximating adele elements by integral elements at finitely many places of a number field.

label: Adic completeness of power series
gloss: A lemma showing that a quotient of a power series ring by an ideal inherits adic completeness.

label: Levi forms and Monge–Ampère operators
gloss: Definitions and small lemmas about Levi forms and Monge–Ampère operators on complex domains.

label: Analytic charts and Osgood's lemma
gloss: Results on building analytic charts for complex functions, including Osgood's lemma and Levi form identities.

label: Local potentials for Levi forms
gloss: Bounds and integrals for local potentials of Levi forms, including estimates on the projective line.

label: Plurisubharmonic functions and Green functions
gloss: Results on plurisubharmonic functions, including integral formulas, Green functions and circle averages.

label: Potential theory on holomorphic atlases
gloss: Lemmas on potentials, holomorphic atlases and Stokes-type identities on complex manifolds.

label: Regular local rings and Rees charts
gloss: Results on regular local rings, using affine schemes and Rees-type charts to describe their geometry.

label: Complex conjugation on CM fields
gloss: Lemmas on complex conjugation and split places for CM fields, including valuations compatible with the conjugation.

label: Complete noetherian local rings
gloss: Core definitions of complete noetherian local rings and of lifts of representations to such rings.

label: Burnside's theorem on surjectivity
gloss: A proof of a surjectivity statement for algebras acting irreducibly on a finite-dimensional vector space.

label: Chebotarev density and Euler products
gloss: Estimates on prime ideal sums and Euler products over cyclotomic fields, leading to a density result.

label: Global class field theory
objects: Abelianization of the absolute Galois group
gloss: Results linking Galois groups of number fields to ideals and S-units through Frobenius elements and inertia groups.

label: Local class field theory
gloss: Proofs about abelian extensions of local fields, using unramified extensions, unit filtrations and Brauer kernels.

label: Compatible sequences of p-adic integers
gloss: A lemma showing that a compatible sequence of finite quotients determines a p-adic integer.

label: Linked ideals and connectedness in codimension
gloss: Definitions and lemmas on linked prime ideals and connectedness in dimension for commutative rings.

label: Cohen–Macaulay rings and depth
gloss: Results on Cohen–Macaulay modules and depth, including the fact that regular local rings are Cohen–Macaulay.

label: Maximal ideal generators of regular rings
gloss: Lemmas counting the generators of the maximal ideal of a regular local ring, via its cotangent space.

label: Heights of polynomial ring ideals
gloss: Results relating heights of prime ideals in polynomial rings to dimension and transcendence degree.

label: Presentations of complete local rings
gloss: Statements about presenting complete local rings as quotients of power series rings.

label: Saturated chains of prime ideals
gloss: Lemmas on saturated chains of prime ideals and how heights add up under localization and quotients.

label: Gorenstein rings and linkage
gloss: Statements about Gorenstein properties and linkage of ideals in noetherian local rings.

label: Hodge–Tate data and dual lattices
gloss: Lemmas on dual lattices and Hodge–Tate data over p-adic rings, many of them Witt vector computations.

label: Eigenframes and number field discriminants
gloss: Bounds on eigenframes of number fields, relating their determinants to the discriminant of the field.

label: Decomposition groups and Galois valuations
gloss: Results on decomposition and inertia groups of Galois actions on valuations, with cup product cocycles.

label: Compact integral adele points
gloss: Lemmas showing that the integral points of certain adele-type sets are open and compact.

label: Asymptotic bounds for sums
objects: Big O and little o asymptotics
gloss: Asymptotic estimates for sums over simplices and sequences involving logarithms.

label: Lattice covolumes and Arakelov degree
gloss: Counting and volume results for lattices, using Gram matrices, fundamental domains and covolumes.

label: Logarithm sum inequality for matrices
gloss: A single inequality bounding a sum of logarithms of matrix entries by a logarithm of their count.

label: Bergman kernels and Morse bounds
gloss: Estimates for Bergman kernels and Morse-type norms on polydiscs, with polar coordinate computations.

label: Monomial integrals over spheres
gloss: Integrals of monomials over spheres and related Gaussian and Gamma function identities.

label: Galois cohomology and inflation maps
gloss: Results on group cohomology, including inflation and restriction maps, long exact sequences and transgression.

label: Local duality hypotheses for Galois cohomology
gloss: Definitions of local finiteness and duality hypotheses used in Galois cohomology arguments.

label: L2 estimates for Dbar
gloss: Core statements of L2 estimates for the Dbar operator on complex manifolds, with Bergman projections.

label: Basic integration by parts identity
gloss: Integral identities used to start the L2 estimates for the Dbar operator, via integration by parts.

label: Wirtinger derivatives in charts
gloss: Lemmas computing Wirtinger derivatives of functions in local charts of a complex manifold.

label: Hörmander's L2 estimate
gloss: The Hörmander L2 estimate for the Dbar operator, with the supporting closedness and evaluation lemmas.

label: Levi form bounds for Dbar
gloss: Pointwise and integral bounds on Levi forms used in the Dbar estimates, including shell and twist bounds.

label: Localization of weighted L2 estimates
gloss: Lemmas that localize L2 estimates to charts, using cutoff functions and smooth transitions.

label: Minimal solutions to Dbar equations
gloss: Existence of minimal-norm solutions to Dbar-type equations, using Riesz representation on Hilbert ranges.

label: Mollifiers and convolution approximation
gloss: Facts about mollifiers: convolution with bump kernels that approximates functions in L2 and pointwise.

label: Norm fibrations in complex analysis
gloss: Lemmas about norm fibrations and their smoothness, used in the Hörmander-style estimates.

label: Plurisubharmonic weighted atlases
gloss: Constructions of weighted charts for plurisubharmonic functions, with Hessian and Jacobian computations.

label: Skoda weights for Dbar estimates
gloss: Weight functions of Skoda type used in L2 estimates, with statements on Levi chains and weighted integrals.

label: Holomorphic sections of symmetric products
gloss: Results on holomorphic sections over symmetric products, using elementary symmetric polynomials and vanishing orders.

label: Weakly holomorphic functions
gloss: Lemmas showing that weakly holomorphic functions are holomorphic, using mollification and bounds on balls.

label: Grunwald–Wang and Hilbert class field
gloss: Results on local fields, including Grunwald–Wang type statements, Hilbert class fields and Frobenius elements.

label: Comparing local field and zeta data
gloss: Comparisons between local field data and Dedekind zeta sums, including Hilbert class field and inertia arguments.

label: Lattice basis reduction
gloss: Lemmas on reduced bases of lattices, using Gram–Schmidt vectors and size-reduction conditions.

label: Arakelov geometry and heights
gloss: A very large set of results on arithmetic geometry, heights and Arakelov theory for reductive group models.

label: Discrete series of real groups
gloss: Results on discrete series representations of real reductive groups, including formal degrees and Casimir eigenvalues.

label: Embeddings into algebraic closures
gloss: A lemma on extending embeddings into algebraically closed fields, using transcendence bases and cardinality.

label: Lattice embeddings into p-adic closures
gloss: Lemmas embedding lattices of number field integers into p-adic algebraic closures, with norm bounds.

label: Characteristic polynomials of integral lattices
gloss: Lemmas computing characteristic polynomials of lattice maps, using a power basis for the ring of integers.

label: Local heights
gloss: Contains only an import file, so it has no mathematics of its own; the name points to local height theory.

label: Finitely generated models
gloss: Two files, an import and a solver, plus a subfolder on finite generation; little mathematics is visible in the digest.

label: Counting primes above a prime
gloss: A lemma counting the primes of a number field over a given set of primes, via ramification and inertia degrees.

label: Symplectic traces and interlacing
gloss: Results on traces of symplectic group representations, with Weyl group characters and interlacing of indices.

label: Trace formulas for lattices
gloss: Trace formula computations for lattices and their quotients, with inertia groups and cocycle conditions.

label: Unramified integrals and modular forms
gloss: Integrals over unramified extensions expressed with power series, modular forms and Eisenstein series.

label: Cardinality of residue fields
gloss: A lemma stating the size of the residue field at a height one prime of a number field.

label: Multiplicative heights and reduction
gloss: Results on multiplicative heights and semistable reduction, with sphere and torus arguments.

label: Quasi-periods of theta functions
gloss: Quasi-period statements for theta functions on the Siegel upper half space, including translation and symmetry laws.

label: Joint eigenvalues on coinvariants
gloss: Definitions and lemmas on coinvariant spaces and joint eigenvalues of commuting real operators.

label: Tail sums over lattice cones
gloss: Estimates on tail sums over lattice points in cones, using determinants and change of variables.

label: Critical line for Dirichlet characters
gloss: Final assembly files that claim the Riemann Hypothesis follows from a statement about all Dirichlet characters.
